$comment: Expectations drafted with `pnpm packs:truth` and reviewed by hand on 2026-10-14, before the pack was scored. Pure insertions (dataCollection blocks, beforeSendLog) are the decisions each repository made, not sites; comment lines that changed with an option are part of that option's site. See ../sentry/RESEARCH.md.

repos.why: Astro site with one Sentry.init passing sendDefaultPii: false and enableLogs: false. Upgrade a6ccab10af9897de8844d1b6ecf17154faf5de9e keeps v10 privacy with an explicit dataCollection and replaces enableLogs: false with beforeSendLog: () => null. TS2353 reports only the first excess property of the literal, so enableLogs has no diagnostic.

findings.note: TS2353 sendDefaultPii; the comment line 16 above it changed with it.
enableLogs: false (lines 20-23 are its comment); replaced by beforeSendLog: () => null.

repos.why: Django app with a Vite/TypeScript frontend; its root tsconfig.json has files: [] and project references, so the truth helper compiled nothing and the site comes from the upgrade commit alone. Merge f0716c561da6818e065ad49050ea076401df0741 (other dependency bumps in it are not Sentry's).

findings.note: sendDefaultPii: true replaced by dataCollection: { userInfo: true }.
